translations.web: All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done.
translations.bsb: Then all mankind will fear and proclaim the work of God; so they will ponder what He has done.
translations.kjv: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.
translations.asv: And all men shall fear; And they shall declare the work of God, And shall wisely consider of his doing.
